problems_addressed.specific_problem: Rebuilding after being voted out of a company
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Focus on building something bigger and better, leveraging past contacts and reputation.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Generating leads without a big budget
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Host open houses for other agents, door knock with purpose, and engage with the community.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Handling a public image with political and personal history
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Embrace your history as a badge of honor and focus on the value you provide.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Lack of systems for tracking leads and clients
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Use free tools like Google Docs and Sheets to create and maintain systems.

episode_summary: Julia Hurley shares her journey of resilience after being voted out of a company she helped build. She provides actionable strategies for lead generation, including hosting open houses and leveraging community engagement. Julia emphasizes the importance of offering value to others and using free tools to create effective business systems.
